text:
maria.sales: Heads-up 04: Devin (regulated payments) asked for a short BYOK POC. Key requirements: keys created in-cust HSM (no export), monthly rotation (they asked 60 vs 90 days), audit logs to their Splunk, strict EU data residency for keys, and option for Dedicated or Private deployment. Can we confirm blockers and rough price delta?
oliver.solutions: Quick Q: do they want Redwood to orchestrate rotations or do they want full control? Also any escrow allowance?
maria.sales: They prefer to orchestrate rotations but Redwood must support atomic rebind without downtime. No Redwood escrow unless court-ordered.
sam.crypto: We support born-in-HSM flows (PKCS#11) for CloudHSM, Luna, Utimaco. For zero-export: customer either exposes PKCS#11 endpoint or we route via a KMS proxy in their VPC. Rotation: we do dual-accept window (configurable, recommend 24h) to avoid failures.
devin.cust: We'll stand up a private HSM, expose a peered endpoint (no public IPs), and can do PKCS#11. We'll provide bastion access for connectivity tests.
oliver.solutions: Networking checklist to send to Devin: CIDR allowlist, DNS name, mTLS cert for Redwood service account, test endpoint, and expected QPS/latency.
maria.sales: Devin mentioned p95 ~100ms for key ops, p99 under 250ms, peak ~120 ops/sec.
sam.crypto: 120 ops/sec is still modest. Need PKCS#11 module version, HSM firmware, supported key types, and vendor import docs. Also confirm tamper-evidence attestation if required (FIPS/FSC).
devin.cust: We'll provide vendor docs and schedule a 90-min preflight on Thursday 14:00 CET. Also attach their internal DR/escrow policy for SOW language.
legal-bot: Engineering/legal will review "escrow-only-under-court-order" phrasing. Also confirm whether monthly rotation <90d triggers ops surcharge.
billing-bot: Note: BYOK private HSM proxy has onboarding fee plus monthly private deployment premium. Dedicated requires commit and has different unit economics. I'll DM a simple delta sheet.
oliver.solutions: Preflight connectivity test to share with Devin's ops team:
```bash
# from customer bastion to our proxy endpoint
openssl s_client -connect kms-proxy.eu-west-1.redwood-internal:443 -servername kms.dev.internal -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/dev-root.pem
# or simple port check
nc -vz kms-proxy.eu-west-1.redwood-internal 443
```
sam.crypto: Also request PKCS#11 slot info and whether they support remote import APIs. If they insist on in-console import, provide runbook steps for customers to import wrapped CMK.
maria.sales: Action items:
1) @oliver.solutions draft SOW snippet with rotation playbook + rollback + escrow invocation path.
2) @sam.crypto confirm vendor compatibility matrix + latency expectations.
3) @billing-bot post onboarding and monthly delta (Dedicated vs Private).
4) @devin.cust send CIDRs, bastion window, and vendor docs.
devin.cust: Will send details today and confirm preflight slot. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
